title: BLS CPI and CES selected bulk time-series files
endpoint_quality: Next-month seasonally adjusted all-items CPI log change

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Whole calendar quarter; forward chronological development folds and2023-onward confirmation. One national economic system, overlapping lag windows and persistent macro shocks; quarters are not independent economies.

calibration_burden: All regression coefficients, centering/scales and flexible centers fit only preceding development blocks. No held-quarter target fitting.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.intended_target: Next-month seasonally adjusted all-items CPI log change
practical_relevance.prediction_time: Only calendar months through t-1 enter predictors for month t. This is a retrospectively revised and seasonally adjusted bulk snapshot, not an as-issued forecast archive. Calendar lags do not establish historical release availability; the nominal origin is after prior-month releases. No month-t prices/employment or CPI accounting decomposition enters inputs.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Revised vintages; no as-issued economic forecast evaluation.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.
Resolve each stated measurement/information restriction with source-bound evidence.
Demonstrate a nondegenerate task with grouping adequate for its explicitly claimed transfer; retain limited scope if the present data cannot do this.
